descriptions.w3d_f2a_pack_palette_8007e998: Obtains bytes from the array wrapper at input offset 48, retaining kind-1 inline storage or calling 0x801ef048 with the original count and arguments 1,2. Packs the high nibbles of 256 consecutive byte triples into 16-bit output entries through caller offset 372 and returns zero. Palette/channel naming and unused frame reservation are inferred.
